CustomField.description: True when a call has Failed and its retry count has reached its Max Retries, or an administrator ticked Manual Dead Letter. Retry does not read it; a call that must never run again is marked Permanent Failure.
CustomField.formula: OR( AND( TEXT(Status__c) = "Failed", Retries__c >= MaxRetries__c ), ManualDeadLetter__c = TRUE )
CustomField.inlineHelpText: True when a call has Failed and its retry count has reached its Max Retries (an incoming call, and a call of a service with no retries, show this as soon as they fail), or Manual Dead Letter is ticked. It says nothing about whether Retry will run the call: see Permanent Failure.
CustomField.label: Dead Lettered
